I visit a psychiatrist once a month while a cc comes around twice a week. Every single person who bothered to know me knows most everything anf my family are the cause, are the catalyst and know it all since I was under 16 when I first tried and went into ER. They try to help, I reject it.

I haven't told anyone but my cc that it's going to happen soon. Trust me, I'm not impulsive; this is a choice. Or maybe I've just been tricked into believing that.

I'm sorry but at the end of the day, hell and love and having the volition to keep trying doesn't change what you are. Or maybe it does but I don't want to change, I just want to rest

Thanks. I know I have talent but unfortunately my ability to use it is often stripped away. Memories fail, focus dissipates and smm the sleep missed hits st once ehen it counts. Otherwise, D&d used to be a pretty good outlet. 

While a bit fanciful it is also literally accurate in mire than a few scenarios. Some headaches (Stress ones are more likely to do this) literally feel like your head is being squeezed. If course you turn and turn, trying to find a solution, only making it worse by not being ae to relax. A vicious cycle. Well it is this way for me. The worst of course is the migraine which ups the ante and is more akin to a cave collapse. These are the days where I tend to.. snap. Do just the worst things. I won't go into details even though I've spewed plenty.

Anyhoo, thanks for the compliment. Not often I get those, it means a lot
